desc:
Get ready for a thrilling challenge!
You’ve been locked inside a series of mysterious rooms and have only 60 minutes to escape. Use your logic, creativity, and teamwork to solve puzzles and uncover hidden clues. Every second counts — will you make it out in time or be trapped forever?

For a deeper immersion, we recommend keeping a pen and paper nearby.
Some puzzles will require you to jot down important clues — they could be anywhere: on the walls, hidden in decorations, under objects, or tucked inside unexpected places. Click around the room to interact with anything that looks suspicious or interesting.
If you're playing with friends, communication is key. Remember, you're not escaping alone — you're a team. Working together and combining everyone's thoughts is always better than going solo.
